sources.title: GitHub - Emanmsl/Fake_news_Detection
sources.snippet: This project fine-tunes a pretrained DistilBERT model for binary sequence classification, distinguishing fake political news articles from authentic ones. The pipeline covers the full path from raw CSV text to a trained model: loading and cleaning the source data, tokenizing article text, training the classifier with a custom PyTorch training loop, and evaluating it on a held-out test split.
